obligation: Execute F32x4/F64x2 arithmetic, comparisons, rounding and pseudo-extrema through the existing shared V128/operator path while preserving scalar semantics and operand bits.
representation: A flat Rust macro table is the one authority for SIMD operator/operand/lane facts. The original 27 selectors retain their order; 42 float operators append after them. Existing scalar F32/F64 binary/unary rules project over raw vector lanes, including NaN, signed-zero and rounding semantics. Scalar comparison results expand into full-width all-one/zero lane masks. Pseudo-min/max reuse scalar comparisons for selection but return original operand bits, retaining the first operand for ties/unordered comparisons as the core contract requires. One bounded map_lanes operation reassembles little-endian vector bits. Existing constant/cell/signature/call/GC/host ownership and shared dispatch are unchanged; no new executor, cells, opcodes or residual format. Residual format54 and previous selector meanings remain stable.
scope: The existing 209-file V128/resource/host/lifecycle inventory, including every top-level source containing v128; exact frozen-baseline/current hashes/directive IDs with completed 60-second workers. All floating SIMD files and earlier scalar/resource/callers are included. No full Test262, Wasm, Node compat or performance campaign. A first observation was rejected because its runner changed while a build finished; only completed final-binary reports qualify this change.

controls.obligations: All 42 F32x4/F64x2 operators; ordinary arithmetic/comparison masks, NaN operand order, pseudo-versus-standard signed-zero extrema and ties-even/ceil/floor/trunc signed-zero/halfway cases. All previous 811 controls retained.

checks.internal_obligations: Existing typed ABI, serialized payload/root/GC, host callback/native guard and malformed bytecode-domain checks pass. No representation/lifecycle change or new unit test; floating conformance is exercised through pinned and focused Wast/Node cases.

result.qualification: Exact shared-Wast module/cases. F32x4 and F64x2 arithmetic, comparison masks, unary/rounding, pseudo-extrema operand order, quiet NaN payload selection and signed-zero ties observed as integer bits.

oracle.qualification_limit: One exact module shared with Wast controls, 42 operators and 86 matching integer-bit observations with local Node JITs disabled. Fixture expected I64/unsigned values are hexadecimal strings, preserving every bit through JSON/BigInt. Pinned vector patterns cover arithmetic NaNs and heterogeneous lanes. Does not qualify integer SIMD, conversions, relaxed operators or extended/lane memory forms.
